title: Heritage Short storyboard
description: The single contract between every pipeline stage. Every stage reads this file; none of them write it.

version.description: Bump when the storyboard changes meaningfully, so runs.jsonl can be tied to a version.

languages.description: Narration languages to produce. The first one is the default.

intent.description: What the audience should feel or understand at the end.

visual_prefix.description: Prepended to every keyframe prompt to keep a consistent look.

negative.description: Things to avoid in every image.

description.description: Fixed visual description reused verbatim in every shot the character appears in.

real_person.description: True if this depicts a real person. Requires a consent entry in ETHICS.md.

consent_ref.description: Id of the consent row in ETHICS.md. Keyframes/shots for this character are refused until that row says granted.

voices.description: TTS voice settings per language code.

style_prompt.description: Natural-language delivery direction prepended to the TTS request.

duck_db.description: How far the score drops under narration.

purpose.description: Why this shot exists. Every shot needs a reason you can state.

motion_prompt.description: Camera/subject motion for the image-to-video model.

camera.description: Shot size and angle, e.g. 'wide, eye level'.

video.description: Preferred motion method; kenburns is always the fallback.

narration.description: Narration text keyed by language code. Empty string means no narration on this shot.

subtitle_en.description: English subtitle. Defaults to narration.en when absent.
